title: Natha Khehra Escapes with Rai Singh Under Pursuit

blocks.text: Once the escape is discovered, the Mughal hunt begins in earnest. Natha Khehra escapes with Rai Singh and orders his companions to think first of the child’s survival rather than their own comfort or honor.

He instructs his own kin to carry the boy onward while he and a few others stay near the rear to delay pursuit. The decision is strategic and sacrificial at the same time, because every moment gained may save the child but increase the danger to the rescuers.
As gunfire and shouting close in, the page gathers momentum toward open combat. What began as concealment becomes a moving rear-guard action shaped by loyalty to Mehtab Singh’s house.
